Loss report: gitea -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/ci pipeline.inputs (input environment: a Tekton param with a default is optional, so required is lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Tekton schedules pods, not runner labels)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (inputs) is not written to the Tekton file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: tkn pipeline start ci (a person starts the run with `tkn pipeline start ci`)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
